compendia.name: Characters
compendia.description: The people at the heart of The Cartographer of Rain.

records.name: Mira Vey
records.context:
Age: 24
Appearance: Wiry, dark curls cropped at the jaw, amber raincoat patched at both elbows.
Role: Apprentice cartographer who maps storms by listening to rain strike tuned glass.
Personality: Observant, stubbornly kind, uneasy with authority, prone to describing emotions as weather.
Goal: Prove that the unnatural Glass Tide is being directed toward Lumenport.
Fear: Repeating the mistake that cost her mentor his hearing.
Speech: Precise when nervous; dry humor when she trusts someone.
Equipment: Brass listening fork, waterproof field journal, blue chalk.

records.name: Orin Vale
records.context:
Age: 61
Appearance: Broad-shouldered, silver beard, spectacles connected by a red cord.
Role: Keeper of the Archive of Tides and Mira's former teacher.
Personality: Patient, theatrical, protective of dangerous knowledge.
Secret: He removed one page from the Rain Atlas after discovering it could influence storms, not merely predict them.
Speech: Fond of nautical proverbs that he often invents on the spot.

records.name: Captain Ilyra Seln
records.context:
Age: 39
Appearance: Tall, close-shaved hair, green harbor uniform with a copper whistle.
Role: Captain responsible for Lumenport's sea walls and evacuation routes.
Personality: Decisive, skeptical of folklore, fiercely loyal to dockworkers.
Goal: Keep the harbor open long enough for the outer islands to evacuate.
Speech: Short sentences and direct questions; never raises her voice.
